title: The Farthest Whisper
narration: Beyond the planets, a tiny spacecraft calls home. Its voice takes over a day to reach us. That voice is Voyager one, the most distant thing we've ever made.
visual_goal: Tiny spacecraft against vast stars with faint signal wave.

title: Launch and Legacy
narration: Launched by NASA in nineteen seventy-seven for five years, it outlived that plan nine times over. Like a car running non-stop since the seventies without a tune-up, it's still going.
visual_goal: Historical launch footage transitioning to trajectory animation.

title: The Journey Out
narration: At Jupiter, it found volcanoes on Io. It swept past Saturn, then crossed the heliopause into interstellar space. Voyager one was the first. In 2018, its twin, Voyager two, crossed the same line.
visual_goal: Animated flybys of Jupiter and Saturn, then heliopause crossover.

title: Pale Blue Dot
narration: In nineteen ninety, Voyager turned back and captured Earth—a pale blue dot. Every human who ever lived, reduced to a single pixel of light.
visual_goal: Pale Blue Dot photo zooming out to Voyager far away.

title: The Carries On
narration: Voyager one is the farthest human-made object, tracked by NASA JPL. Its nuclear battery fades, but it still signals. It carries the Golden Record, but the real message is that we sent it at all. We are curious. We explore.
visual_goal: Golden Record close-up, then zoom to Voyager flying into dark.
